To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have designed, prototyped, and evaluated an effective and efficient Host Based Intrusion detection and Prevention system for Android (Hidroid) which can run completely on a mobile devices.
HIDROID is a novel Host based Intrusion Detection and prevention system for Android, which is completely running on a mobile device with no need of any external server or cloud.

HIDROID is a novel host based IDPS for mobile devices, which can run completely on the device, without any connection to the server, and it is well capable of detecting malicious behavior, while keeping the false positive rate at minimum.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a lightweight IDPS for mobile devices.
the development of a lightweight, data driven, Host based IDPS that runs completely on a smartphone.
the design and implementation of a novel, data driven, host based IDPS for the Android operating system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HIDROID is a practical, lightweight, and privacy preserving IDPS, with a high detection accuracy, which is well suitable for real world usage on mobile devices.

HIDROID is a novel, efficient, and effective Host based IDPS that runs on a mobile device with minimal computation burden, and is capable of learning the normal behavior of the device, while detecting any abnormal behavior in real time.
, HIDROID is an innovative IDPS that runs entirely on the mobile device, and does not require any external data collection and processing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HIDROID is able to provide an efficient and effective protection against malicious applications, with minimal impact on the performance of a mobile device.
we have developed an efficient, effective and privacy preserving behavioral IDPS, which runs completely on the device, with a minimum computation overhead.
HIDROID is able to detect a malicious behavior, with an acceptable accuracy, in a real life device.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, with minimal computation overhead, HIDROID can effectively detect and prevent malicious behaviors on a mobile device without relying on a central server.
HIDROID is a viable alternative to existing IDPS for Android.

, by leveraging the power of data mining and machine learning, we can develop a lightweight IDPS that runs completely on the device, and requires no data collection or processing on a remote server, which helps to mitigate the risk of sensitive leakage and the violation on privacy.
